Anthony Edwards was born on August 5, 2001.
Anthony Edwards is nicknamed "Ant-Man" or simply "Ant".
Anthony Edwards is an American professional basketball player.
Anthony Edwards plays for the Minnesota Timberwolves of the National Basketball Association (NBA).
Anthony Edwards is a shooting guard.
Anthony Edwards played college basketball for the Georgia Bulldogs.
Anthony Edwards was selected with the first overall pick by the Minnesota Timberwolves in the 2020 NBA draft.
Anthony Edwards has been named an All-Star during the 2022–23 and 2023–24 seasons.
Anthony Edwards won a gold medal on the 2024 U.S. Olympic team.
Anthony Edwards finished his high school career at Holy Spirit Preparatory School in Atlanta, Georgia.
Holy Spirit Preparatory School is Anthony Edwards's hometown.
Anthony Edwards was rated a consensus five-star recruit by major recruiting services.
Anthony Edwards was one of the best players in the 2019 class according to major recruiting services.
Anthony Edwards earned McDonald's All-American and USA Today All-USA first team honors as a senior at Holy Spirit Preparatory School.
Anthony Edwards committed to play college basketball for Georgia.
Georgia is Anthony Edwards's highest-rated recruit destination.
Tom Crean was the head coach of the Georgia Bulldogs when Anthony Edwards played there.
Anthony Edwards made his debut for the Georgia Bulldogs on November 5, 2019.
Anthony Edwards recorded 24 points, 9 rebounds, and 4 steals in his debut game against Western Carolina.
Dominique Wilkins holds the record for most points by a Georgia freshman debutant since 1979.
Anthony Edwards scored a season-high 37 points in a loss to Michigan State at the Maui Invitational on November 26, 2019.
Jacky Dorsey was the last Georgia freshman to score at least 37 points in a game before Anthony Edwards in 1975.
Anthony Edwards led all scorers with 24 points and made the game-winning shot against Chaminade in his final Maui Invitational game.
Anthony Edwards recorded 29 points and 15 rebounds, both game-highs, in a victory over Texas A&M on February 1, 2020.
Anthony Edwards led all scorers with 32 points in a loss to Florida on the same day he scored 29 points against Texas A&M.
Anthony Edwards scored 36 points and collected seven rebounds, four assists, and four steals in an overtime defeat to South Carolina on February 26, 2020.
As a freshman, Anthony Edwards averaged 19.1 points, 5.2 rebounds, and 2.8 assists per game.
Anthony Edwards was the top scorer on his team as a freshman.
Anthony Edwards earned second-team All-SEC honors as a freshman.
Anthony Edwards earned SEC Freshman of the Year honors as a freshman.
Anthony Edwards collected SEC Freshman of the Week accolades four times during the season, the most in program history.
Anthony Edwards was one of five finalists for the Jerry West Award as a freshman.
Anthony Edwards declared for the 2020 NBA draft after his freshman year.
Anthony Edwards signed with an agent and forgave his remaining college basketball eligibility.
The 2020 NBA draft was delayed by five months due to the COVID-19 pandemic.
Minnesota Timberwolves selected Anthony Edwards as the No. 1 overall pick on draft night in November 2020.
Anthony Edwards made his NBA debut on December 23, 2020.
In his NBA debut, Anthony Edwards put up 15 points, 4 rebounds, and 4 assists in a win against the Detroit Pistons.
On March 18, 2021, Anthony Edwards scored a then career-high 42 points, along with 7 rebounds and 3 assists, in a game against the Phoenix Suns.
Anthony Edwards became the third-youngest player to score 40+ points in NBA history after his performance on March 18, 2021.
After the season, Anthony Edwards finished second in Rookie of the Year voting and was named to the NBA All-Rookie First Team.
On November 10, 2021, Anthony Edwards scored a then career-high 48 points on 7 three-pointers in a loss to the Golden State Warriors.

In a win over the Portland Trail Blazers on January 25, 2022, Anthony Edwards became the first player in NBA history to record a stat line of at least 40 points, 9 rebounds, 3 blocks, 3 steals, and 5 three-pointers in a single game.
On April 7, 2022, Anthony Edwards scored a career-high 49 points in a win over the San Antonio Spurs.
In his playoff debut on April 16, 2022, Anthony Edwards logged 36 points and 6 assists in a Game 1 win over the Memphis Grizzlies.
Minnesota lost to Memphis despite Anthony Edwards's 30-point, 5-rebound, 5-assist, 2-steal, and 2-block outing in Game 6 of the playoffs.

On January 21, 2023, Anthony Edwards scored a season-high 44 points, including a season-high 8 three-pointers, along with 6 rebounds, 4 assists, 3 steals, and 3 blocks in a win over the Houston Rockets.
Anthony Edwards was named an All-Star for the first time in his career as a reserve on February 10, 2023.
On April 9, 2023, Anthony Edwards recorded 26 points, 13 rebounds, 4 assists, 4 steals, and 4 blocks to help lead the Timberwolves to a win over the New Orleans Pelicans.
Anthony Edwards changed his jersey number from #1 to #5 before the 2023–24 season.

On November 13, 2023, Anthony Edwards was named the NBA Western Conference Player of the Week for the first time in his career after leading Minnesota to an undefeated week (4–0) with averages of 31.3 points, 6.3 rebounds, 6.8 assists, and 2.0 steals.
On January 27, 2024, Anthony Edwards recorded 32 points, 6 rebounds, and a career-high 12 assists in a loss to the San Antonio Spurs.
Anthony Edwards was named to his second All-Star Game as an Western Conference reserve on February 1, 2024.
On April 9, 2024, Anthony Edwards put up a career-high 51 points in a win over the Washington Wizards.
At the end of the season, Anthony Edwards was named to the All-NBA Second Team for the first time in his career.
In Game 4 of the first round of the playoffs against Phoenix, Anthony Edwards scored 31 of his 40 points in the second half, along with nine rebounds and six assists in a win to close out the series.
Anthony Edwards surpassed Kevin Garnett for the most 30-point playoff games in Timberwolves franchise history, with eight.
In Game 1 of the Western Conference Semifinals, Anthony Edwards scored a then playoff career-high and franchise postseason-record 43 points in a win over the Nuggets.
Anthony Edwards joined Kobe Bryant as the only players with consecutive 40-point games at age 22 or younger in NBA postseason history.

In Game 4 of the Western Conference Semifinals, Anthony Edwards scored a playoff career-high and franchise postseason-record 44 points, along with five rebounds and five assists, in a loss to the Nuggets.
In Game 4 of the Western Conference Finals, Anthony Edwards posted a near triple-double with 29 points, 10 rebounds, and 9 assists in a win over the Dallas Mavericks.
Minnesota lost to Dallas in five games despite Anthony Edwards's 28-point, 9-rebound, and 6-assist outing in Game 5 of the Western Conference Finals.
Anthony Edwards was a member of the United States national team that competed in the 2023 FIBA Basketball World Cup.
Anthony Edwards started all eight games for the U.S. national team during the 2023 FIBA Basketball World Cup.
Anthony Edwards was selected in the All-FIBA World Cup Team after the 2023 FIBA Basketball World Cup.
Anthony Edwards was the leading scorer for the U.S., averaging 18.9 points per game during the 2023 FIBA Basketball World Cup.
The United States finished fourth place at the 2023 FIBA Basketball World Cup.
Anthony Edwards was named to the 2024 Olympic team after the 2023 FIBA Basketball World Cup.
Edwards's mother, Yvette, died of cancer in 2015 when he was in eighth grade.
Edwards's grandmother, Shirley, also died of cancer in 2015 when he was in eighth grade.
Edwards wore the No. 5 basketball jersey since high school to honor his deceased family members who both died on the fifth day of the month.
After their deaths, Edwards was raised by his sister, Antoinette, and brother, Antoine, who shared legal custody of him.
In high school, Edwards frequently worked as an instructor at youth camps.
Edwards intended to major in marketing while attending the University of Georgia.
During his childhood, Edwards also starred in baseball, often acting as his team's fourth or fifth hitter in the batting order.
Edwards has jokingly said he was very skilled at a variety of sports when he was younger.
Edwards owns two dogs and has expressed his affinity for lions, although he does not believe he has the requisite space to care for one.
Edwards made his acting debut in the 2022 sports drama film Hustle.
In September 2022, Edwards posted a video to Instagram story referring to a group of shirtless men standing on a sidewalk with a homophobic slur.
The NBA fined Edwards $40,000 for using "offensive and derogatory language" in his Instagram post.
In December 2023, Paige Jordae accused Edwards of impregnating her and then offering her $100,000 to get an abortion.
Edwards responded that he was handling his personal matters privately.
